# Dangling Pages Risk

There is a risk of dangling pages if an owner entity is removed after the page has been generated, leaving the page on disk without a valid owner reference. This could lead to stale or irrelevant content remaining in the generated wiki.

**Anchored to:**

- `knowledge_compiler/wiki/emitter.py` — `knowledge_compiler.wiki.emitter.WikiEmitter.emit`
- `knowledge_compiler/wiki/emitter.py` — `knowledge_compiler.wiki.emitter.WikiEmitter._prune_orphaned_pages`
